answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in nebula, checked in fable, and reef makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3248 identities would post 2877 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
